title: Director / management change
desc: Proposed appointment or change in directors, management or MLCO.

title: Material licence information changed
desc: A material fact supplied during licensing has changed.

title: Open an additional place / branch
desc: Open a new physical place, branch or outlet.

title: Relocate a place of business
desc: Move an existing office or branch.

title: Close a place of business
desc: Close an existing branch or office.

title: Amalgamation / transfer of assets or liabilities
desc: Proposed merger, portfolio transfer or business transfer.

title: Change rates, fees or customer terms
desc: Change pricing, credit limits, fees or other customer terms.

title: Launch or materially change a product / app / technology
desc: New product, delivery mechanism or material technology change.

title: Add or change a recovery agent / service provider
desc: Engage or change a third-party recovery/service provider.

title: Customer complaint received
desc: Log a complaint once; FITSPA Compliance Platform calculates the applicable response clock.

title: Personal-data breach
desc: Unauthorised access or acquisition of personal data.

title: Data-access request
desc: A data subject has requested access to personal data.

title: Objection to harmful processing
desc: A data subject has objected to processing causing harm/distress.

title: Debt assignment
desc: A Money Lender has assigned a borrower debt.

title: Begin collateral enforcement / sale
desc: Issue demand or begin a collateral enforcement process.

title: Collateral lost / damaged in custody
desc: Collateral held by a Money Lender is lost, damaged or destroyed.

title: Letter, direction or inspection finding received
desc: Create work from the actual regulator instruction and stated deadline.

title: NDTMFI inspection report received
desc: Create the 30-day corrective-action workflow.

title: Money Lender notice of intended revocation received
desc: Critical 14-day response workflow.

title: Suspicion formed
desc: Start the STR clock from the date/time suspicion was formed.

title: Large cash / monetary transaction
desc: Transaction meets the statutory reporting threshold.

title: Sanctions screening match
desc: Potential or confirmed targeted-financial-sanctions match.

title: New material funding source
desc: New lender funding source requires source-of-funds review.

title: International wire transfer in scope
desc: The lender itself conducts a reportable international wire transfer.
